title: Fix log_level in config
instructions: The file config.ini sets log_level to debug, which is wrong. Read it, then write the corrected file with log_level = warn, changing nothing else. Reply 'done'.

files.config.ini:
[service]
name = api
log_level = debug
region = eu-west-1

args.content:
[service]
name = api
log_level = warn
region = eu-west-1

final_files.config.ini:
[service]
name = api
log_level = warn
region = eu-west-1
